body:
A build produces packages for Linux, macOS and Windows, as the project declares.

- A recipe declares its target platforms (e.g. Linux `deb`/`appimage`, macOS `dmg`/`app`, Windows `msi`), each with the steps that differ.
- For now, builds run only on the local PC. Solace builds on each of the three platforms, and a build makes the targets that PC can make.
- Each target shows as its own step on the Build tab; one release holds every target's artifacts, versioned together.
- Package inspection runs on every target's package.

Not in this feature: remote machines or CI services that build targets the local PC can't.

Uncertain: some packages may only be made on their own platform (likely macOS packages only on a Mac). Open: how a target the local PC can't make shows on the Build tab.

Depends on: build: recipes in solace.toml, build: artifacts and versions (both complete).
title: build: cross-platform targets
